text: This report seeks approval to amend the Fire Route By-law to designate certain locations as fire routes within the meaning of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 880, as amended. It was previously considered by the Toronto and East York Community Council at its meeting on February 21, 2018. On March 2, 2018, City Council's delegation of fire route designations to Community Councils came into effect. City Council no longer has jurisdiction to deal with this matter. Community Councils now have final decision making authority for fire route designations. As a result, this report is resubmitted to Community Council for further consideration and final decision under the delegated authority in Subsection 27-152 F(1) of Chapter 27, Council Procedures.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated part or those parts of the private road or roads shown on the site plan filed with the Fire Chief and General Manager, Toronto Fire in respect of the municipal address set out below, as a fire route pursuant to Municipal Code Chapter 880 - Fire Routes - 20 Minowan Miikan Lane. 2. Authorized the Fire Chief and General Manager, Toronto Fire and the City Solicitor to take the appropriate action to make a designated Fire Route.
